_versioning.purpose: Track code changes, deprecations, and story evolution across the YourWorld verse

_rules.immutable_codes: Once a code is assigned, it NEVER changes meaning. Only deprecated.
_rules.deprecation: Deprecated codes remain valid for historical data but shouldn't be used in new data.
_rules.supersession: When code A is superseded by code B, all future queries use B, but A still resolves.
_rules.story_evolution: Canon changes are marked with effective_from_tick - past events keep old canon.

code_status.ACTIVE: Currently valid, use in new data
code_status.DEPRECATED: Still resolves, but don't use in new data
code_status.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by another code, use replacement
code_status.RETCON: Canon changed - applies from specific tick forward

evolution_log._desc: All changes to codes are logged here with effective dates/ticks

supersession_registry._desc: Codes that have been superseded by newer codes

retcon_registry._desc: Canon changes that apply from a specific tick forward
retcon_registry._note: Past events keep old canon, future events use new canon

query_resolution_rules._desc: How the system resolves codes based on tick context

rule_2_deprecated.action: Return original definition + deprecation warning + suggested replacement

rule_3_historical.action: Check timeline_markers, return state at that tick

rule_4_retcon.query: Resolve retconned data at tick N
rule_4_retcon.action: If tick < effective_tick: return old_canon. Else: return new_canon

rule_5_character_full.query: Get full character C01 at tick N
action: 2. Apply timeline_markers up to tick N
3. Check retcon_registry for any retcons before tick N
4. Resolve all embedded codes (SH001 -> full shoe definition)
5. Return complete character state at tick N

pulling_strategy._desc: How to minimize data loading while maintaining interconnection

lazy_loading.step_2: Load only: C01 base, C01 timeline markers up to 5000

lazy_loading.step_6: Load weather/time only if scene requires
